summary: CriminalRecordsCheckEditAll is a UserControl in the HSPnet enrollment module for editing and updating multiple students' criminal record check (CRC) statuses in a grid view. It provides multi-row edit, save, and validation capabilities with role-based read-only/view logic, and implements complex workflow navigation and data handling associated with CRC statuses for students.
purpose: To allow authorized users to efficiently view, edit, and save CRC status and related information for a cohort or group of students in a single, editable grid interface, supporting bulk operations and UI controls for status tracking.

workflows.name: Bulk Edit and Save CRC Statuses
steps: Display student list in gridDataEdit with CRC status fields
Filter students by cohort, term, course, section, action, and campus
Allow edits to CRCStatus, CRCStatusDate, CRCStatusNotes for each student if not read-only
Mark edited records as dirty (txtDirty) using javascript and hidden fields
Pressing Save All or Save Edit Next triggers validation and update for all edited records
If there are update warnings, display warnings and halt redirect
On success, redirect to either EnrollmentEditAll.aspx for next set or Enrollment.aspx as appropriate
For single row edit, only one record is updated and redirect follows same as above

workflows.name: Grid Display and UI Dynamics
steps: Show/Hide Save All or navigation buttons based on number of records and page size
Dynamically bind dropdown lists and set values for CRCStatus
Hide grid and navigation elements if not applicable (ex: less than 14 rows)
Setup javascript variables for tracking dirty rows and hook up setDirty calls
Disable all grid editing UI if in read-only mode

business_rules: Only users with appropriate rights can edit CRC statuses; otherwise grid is read-only.
Dirty flag (txtDirty) is required to determine which rows should be updated.
For bulk operations, only rows marked as dirty are processed.
After save, warnings must be checked before redirecting.
Dropdown for CRCStatusCodeID is populated from Codes.CodeSearch using user session.
Navigation buttons are displayed or hidden based on the number of grid rows and pagination.
validations: User session must be valid for any data operations.
Data binding and updates only occur if not in read-only mode.
If not enough rows for paging, navigation and Save All controls are hidden.
Dropdown selection must be valid for CRCStatus.
calculations: Next page start row (StartRow + PageSize) for navigation.
Grid sort expression and direction for data ordering.
Checkbox/flag logic for ShowGrad, ShowInactive, ShowWaived, etc.
conditions: If EnrollmentID > 0, modify grid and show/hide buttons accordingly.
If EnrollmentID == 0, hide Save All and Cancel if under 14 rows.
If grid is read-only, all input controls and update logic are disabled.
system_behavior: Implements dynamic data-binding and paging in grid view.
Performs javascript integration for UI state (dirty row tracking).
Handles redirects after save based on user's actions and outcome of update/warnings.
Supports both synchronous and asynchronous postbacks for grid operations.
dependencies: Codes.CodeSearch for populating CRC status codes.
exceptions: Operation cancelled if UserSession is null.
Save/update not performed on read-only grids.
On update, if warnings are present, redirect is stopped and user is notified.
content_gaps: No explicit UI layout, database table schema or user-facing error messages.
No details on the exact validation logic for each edit field.
No list of CRC statuses or example record contents.
No specifics on role/rights matrix for read-only vs. editable usage.
